I replied to Ilse in our DM: the possible move to Bay 35 for the Tansley Parcel depot stays between us and is treated as unconfirmed. I said I'd help once it's official.

To keep it private:
- I didn't post anything in a channel, message anyone else, or save it to GBrain or memory.
- I checked GBrain first, as your instructions ask. That was a read-only search, and it found no notes about the depot or Bay 35. Search was in keyword-only mode, so that isn't proof the notes don't exist.
